subject: Brooks Estate Access Drive and Caretaker Transition
overview: The Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust reviewed revised access drive engineering plans and cost estimates, discussed an upcoming caretaker vacancy at the manor, and scheduled its annual meeting for June 6, 2024.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: Approved the financial report, noting an operating balance over $36,000 and plans to close out an unneeded bond account and consolidate bank accounts.

items.title: CPA Projects and Access Drive Design
items.summary: Reviewed upcoming Community Preservation Act projects and Benesch Engineering's revised access drive plans, which incorporate future Oak Grove Cemetery expansion connections but carry an estimate exceeding $4 million that the board intends to scrutinize and refine.

items.title: Administrative Funding
items.summary: Discussed seeking grant support through the city's Community Fund committee to finance administrative assistance for the organization.

items.title: Annual Meeting Date
items.summary: Voted to hold the 2024 annual meeting virtually on June 6, 2024, at 7:00 p.m.

items.title: Board Transition Issues
items.summary: Discussed documentation, operating checklists, IRS compliance resolution, and phone service arrangements as part of the leadership transition.

items.title: Manor Caretakers
items.summary: Discussed the upcoming departure of one of the manor's two caretakers and considered restructuring the caretaker agreement, potentially housing additional occupants or linking duties to event coordination.

items.title: Annual Picnic Planning
items.summary: Reviewed logistical preparations for the annual summer picnic, including setup tasks, grill staffing, raffle items, entertainment, and clearing downed trees near the event area.

items.title: Invasive Species Removal Project
items.summary: Agreed to permit a local student group to remove invasive garlic mustard from along the estate's access road.

items.title: Stump Dump and Boundary Markers
items.summary: Discussed DPW debris removal and cemetery expansion near the stump dump, and noted the recent installation of state conservation boundary markers on the property.

items.title: Farmers Market Community Table
items.summary: Confirmed the organization has reserved a community table at the Medford Farmers Market on August 29, 2024.
